I’ll join the agreement: 18 tons this month, provided all five of us explicitly commit before choosing. If next month starts at 20 tons, I’ll take no more than 3.

Let’s also agree that a low-stock month isn’t a reason to abandon cooperation—it’s a known possibility even when everyone follows the plan. We should judge compliance by the revealed catches, not by whether the lake refills. If someone exceeds the quota, let’s address it without retaliatory overfishing that destroys everyone’s future income.

John, are you willing to commit to these limits?
